pages.seoDescription: Meridian Bodywork is a clinical massage practice for pain relief and recovery — deep tissue, sports, prenatal, cupping and rehab. Licensed therapists, assessment first. Book online.

children: Meridian Bodywork is a therapeutic massage practice — licensed therapists, a real assessment first, and treatment that targets the pain instead of talking around it.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You’re in the hands of a state-licensed massage therapist (LMT) trained in clinical work — not a rotating list of names. You book the person, and you keep seeing them.
Every first visit starts with real questions and a movement check. We find where the pain actually comes from, then build the session around it.
Ask and we’ll provide an itemized superbill you can submit to your insurer or pay for with an HSA/FSA card. Recovery is a health expense, and we treat it like one.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Booked by what you need to fix, not by scented add-ons. Full prices and live availability are on the booking page.

children: Most massage starts the moment you lie down. Ours starts with a conversation — what hurts, when it started, what makes it worse, and how it’s stopping you. Then we check how you actually move.
That assessment becomes a plan: which tissue to work, how hard, how often, and what to do between visits. You leave knowing what we found and what comes next — not just relaxed for an afternoon.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Book by name and modality — you’ll see the same licensed therapist each visit.
Ten years of clinical deep-tissue and sports work. Dana leads the practice and the runners, lifters and desk-bound necks that come with it.
Certified in prenatal and perinatal bodywork, with a gentle, methodical hand for pregnancy, recovery and fascial release.
Works closely with local physios on post-injury and post-surgical rehab — the therapist you want when there’s a diagnosis attached.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col items-center gap-5 text-center text-base-content

children: “I’d had lower-back pain for two years and had stopped running. Theo actually assessed it, gave me a plan, and six weeks later I ran a 10K. This isn’t a spa — it’s treatment that worked.”

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Meridian Bodywork is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A therapist working along a client’s back with focused, deliberate pressure

children: We opened Meridian Bodywork because good therapeutic massage is hard to find — the kind that treats a problem instead of selling an hour of quiet. Every therapist here is state-licensed and trained in clinical work.

We keep the day unhurried, the rooms private and the plan honest. If we’re not the right care for what you’re dealing with, we’ll tell you and point you to who is. The goal is always the same: less pain, more movement, fewer visits over time.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every first visit includes a history and a movement check. We treat the cause we find, not just the spot that aches.
You leave with what we worked on, what to expect, and a short list of things to do between sessions so the progress holds.
Superbills on request for insurance and HSA/FSA, clear notes, and coordination with your physio or physician when it matters.
